create_masked_seq2seq_file_channel: create a MaskedSeq2SeqFileChannel to generate prediction output rows with doc index, raw input, tokenized input, predictions, and targets
build_masked_seq2seq_topk_reporter: build a MaskedSeq2SeqTopKMetricReporter from config to track exact match, BLEU, and length metrics for masked seq2seq models
calculate_masked_seq2seq_metrics: calculate masked seq2seq top-k metrics including exact match, BLEU score, and length reports from aggregated predictions and targets
aggregate_masked_seq2seq_targets: aggregate target sequences by removing pad, BOS, and EOS tokens and storing cleaned targets with their lengths
aggregate_masked_seq2seq_preds: aggregate beam search predictions by removing special tokens and storing stringified beam results for top-k evaluation
